retention.note: Memory checks (Claude's defaults 2026-11-20, owner may change): first one 14 days after platform mastery, the second 28 days after the first was passed. 3 whole problems, one try each, no hints; 2 of 3 right holds up. A miss puts a refresher on the path ('Putting it together', straight to the whole problems). dueSlackDays: the server accepts a check up to this many days early (device clocks differ).

verification.note: Paper test: 5 of 6 suggests verified (owner decision 2026-11-19). The teacher makes the final call.

paths.note: Owner decision 2026-11-20: students move on while waiting for the teacher; 'with your teacher first' items stay on the path as a flag. Set to true to lock lessons that build on an unchecked foundation.

practice.note: Practice for a check (student's choice, owner request 2026-11-20): 6 whole problems like the paper test, 2 warm-ups then 4 at the hardest level. Never changes mastery or the path; counts as participation.
